snippet.title: Rave Heart+ | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The time has come! Rave Heart is reborn once again! Rave Heart+, the definitive edition, is now available on Steam and the Epic Games Store!

A tiny sci-fi RPG with a big heart.
Featuring original music, voice acting, and lots of charm!

STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1375880/Rave_Heart/
EPIC GAMES STORE: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/rave-heart-plus-c042cd

#indiegame #steam #epicgames
